title: Trove
tagline: Personal finance, encrypted in your own Google Drive
description: Balances and transactions are encrypted in the browser before they ever leave it. The server never holds a copy. Passkey sign-in, no passwords.

title: Ingenious
tagline: The tile-matching board game, playable online
description: Build lines of matching symbols and keep all six colours moving. Your score is only as good as your weakest one. Solo and multiplayer boards.
